Hello Professor Alvarez,

I'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. Looking at my schedule, I have free slots on:

- Monday 10:00-10:30
- Thursday 14:00-14:30

Would either of those work for you? If not, tell me when you're free and I'll fit in around it.

Thanks,
Omar

Hello Omar,

Monday 10:00-10:30 works — it's in my calendar now. Thursday 14:00-14:30 I can't: I have a 1:1 until 14:20 and the curriculum committee right after.

See you Monday at 10:00.

Professor Alvarez
